Question.title: Question
Question.description: An educational field-challenge or quiz question in the Vulture Arena question bank (zero PII).

id.description: Unique identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

missionTitle.description: Short mission title shown above the prompt.

assignedTeamIds.description: Bounded list of team IDs assigned to this question.

points.description: Points awarded for a correct answer.

isActive.description: Whether the question is currently active in gameplay.

isPendingAnswer.description: Whether the correct answer is still pending teacher entry.

mediaUrl.description: External HTTPS URL, bundled asset path, or questionMedia document reference.

mediaDocId.description: Optional reference ID in the questionMedia collection for compressed teacher images.

speciesFocus.description: Bounded list of target vulture species.

options.description: Answer options for multiple_choice, multiple_choice_multi, or image_matching.

correctAnswer.description: Correct answer option ID (string) or boolean flag for true_false.

promptImage.description: Optional prompt image reference for image_matching.

stationLocation.description: Station location label for qr_scan questions.

qrPayload.description: Expected QR payload token for qr_scan questions.

fieldClue.description: Field clue shown for qr_scan questions.

taskPrompt.description: Field task prompt for photo_upload or video_upload.

verificationCriteria.description: Verification checklist items for field upload tasks.

targetSubject.description: Target subject identifier for field upload tasks.

durationSecondsMax.description: Maximum allowed duration in seconds for video_upload.

orderIndex.description: Deterministic display sort index preserving original bank order.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last administrative update.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher/admin who last saved the question.

QuestionBankMeta.title: QuestionBankMeta
QuestionBankMeta.description: Authoritative metadata and version counter for cross-device question bank synchronization.

totalCount.description: Total number of questions in the bank.

activeCount.description: Number of active questions in the bank.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest bank synchronization.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher/admin who triggered the sync.

QuestionMedia.title: QuestionMedia
QuestionMedia.description: Compressed teacher-uploaded question photograph stored separately from main question metadata to remain well below Firestore's 1 MiB document limit.

questionId.description: Associated question ID matching this document ID.

byteSize.description: Approximate decoded image size in bytes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the media document was saved.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher/admin who uploaded the image.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized teacher administrator record containing restricted account metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was last updated.

/questions/{questionId}.description: Permanent question bank documents (publicly readable curriculum items, writable strictly by verified admins).

/questionBankMeta/{metaId}.description: Synchronization version and bank count metadata (publicly readable, writable strictly by verified admins).

/questionMedia/{questionId}.description: Compressed teacher-uploaded photographs stored per question (publicly readable during gameplay, writable strictly by verified admins).

/admins/{uid}.description: Authorized teacher admin allowlist documents (strictly isolated PII, readable only by owner or admin, writable strictly by bootstrapped admin).
